data.name: eq.diag.formula.D
data.value: Coverage = valid minutes ÷ period minutes; flat-line = non-zero value unchanged ≥ flat-line minutes; state conflict = RUN / LOADED disagreeing with kW (rated × 5%)

data.name: eq.diag.formula.P
data.value: Trigger: supply P50 > required × margin; reducible = end-use P05 − required (no end-use: supply P05 − required − drop reserve), floored to trial step; savings = bar × 5%~6% × period kWh

data.name: eq.diag.formula.L
data.value: Leak ratio = median non-production residual flow ÷ production average flow; kWh = flow (low/mid/high) × specific power (P25/P50/P75) × non-production hours

data.name: eq.diag.formula.S1
data.value: Unloaded ratio = unloaded min ÷ (loaded + unloaded min)

data.name: eq.diag.formula.S2
data.value: For each unloaded period, minutes beyond the candidate delay × measured unloaded kW; periods ending in reload add one start

data.name: eq.diag.formula.S3
data.value: P50 / P95 of unloaded→loaded transitions per running hour (≥ 30 min)

data.name: eq.diag.formula.S4
data.value: Share of multi-unit running time with two or more units unloaded (or VSD < full %)

data.name: eq.diag.formula.S5
data.value: Share of joint running time with VSD ≥ full % while a fixed-speed unit is unloaded

data.name: eq.diag.formula.S6
data.value: Units running ≥ 1 h with < 1% loaded; savings = their running kWh

data.name: eq.diag.formula.E1
data.value: Flow × pressure cells, compared only with ≥ min hours in both periods; difference weighted by recent kWh, interval ± 1.96 × SE; lower bound > 0 and center > threshold = degraded

data.name: eq.diag.formula.E2
data.value: Fixed-speed: loaded ratio < threshold and frequent cycling; VSD: share of time near minimum load > threshold

data.name: eq.diag.formula.E3
data.value: Minutes with all units fully loaded and supply pressure < required ≥ threshold

data.name: eq.diag.formula.E4
data.value: Control type = inlet modulation; average load < 60% suggests VSD, otherwise fixed-speed + storage

data.name: eq.diag.overlap.p_l_overlap
data.value: Excess pressure and leakage both triggered: leakage falls as pressure drops, so their savings cannot simply be added

data.name: eq.diag.overlap.l_s_overlap
data.value: Leakage / idle loss and shutdown delay / never-loaded both triggered: unloaded running energy in non-production hours is counted in both, so savings cannot simply be added

data.name: eq.diag.overlap.s2_s6_overlap
